title: CORS is a browser rule

blocks.md:
## Not Node, not this sandbox

The **browser** asks: may this page’s origin read that response? CORS is an HTTP header conversation the *browser* enforces.

Node `fetch` and this lesson stub do **not** simulate CORS. `capabilities.network: false` also does not claim to be an OS firewall. The idea still matters when you later ship a page.

blocks.explainMd: A server can send Access-Control-Allow-Origin. The browser decides whether page JS may read the body.

description: The browser decides whether page code may read another origin.
